stories.title: Big Ten officially bans NFL players from return
stories.summary: The Big Ten has passed a rule that stops players returning from the NFL from playing for one of its schools.

stories.title: Bengals star Chase 'fine' after knee injury scare
stories.summary: Bengals star Ja'Marr Chase says he is "fine" after an injury scare at practice in which the WR appeared to injure his knee.

stories.title: Kiffin pushes back on eligibility double standard
stories.summary: Lane Kiffin said that the SEC and Big Ten are using a moralistic double standard by allowing certain players with court orders to play while attempting to ban others.

stories.title: No gimmes: PGA path for LIV pros not promised
stories.summary: PGA Tour CEO/commissioner Brian Rolapp said the tour has no current plan to bring back LIV golfers Bryson DeChambeau, Jon Rahm and Cameron Smith.

stories.title: Kubiak mum on details, but Jeanty 'on the mend'
stories.summary: Asked Tuesday about the severity of Ashton Jeanty's injury or if the second-year player will begin the season on the injured reserve, coach Klint Kubiak simply said, "He's on the mend."
